item.title: Iran : Oil depots hit by Israeli-US strikes
item.summary: Strikes in #Iran hit #oil depots overnight on 7–8 March, killing several people and triggering fires. #Tehran woke under thick #smoke and #toxic rain as the regime has just appointed its new #supreme #leader.

item.title: In pictures: International Women's Day rallies around the world
item.summary: Women across the world rallied for equal rights, female empowerment and an end to gender-based discrimination and violence as they marked International Women's Day on Sunday, with many events also denouncing the war in the Middle East sparked by US-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Israel pounds Lebanon: 83 children among almost 400 killed in a week
item.summary: Lebanon’s Health Minister says 83 children were among nearly 400 people killed in a week of fighting between Hezbollah and Israel. For more on the situation, Sarah El-Yafi, Public Policy and International Affairs Specialist, provides further details.
